_context.link_channel: Watch: name of the notification channel for the always-on background service that keeps the Bluetooth link to the phone. Users see it in the watch's notification settings and may turn it off.
_context.link_text: Watch: body of that always-on notification (title is the brand 'SHM Bridge', not translated). Must be short: round watch screen.
_context.alarm_channel: Watch: notification channel name for alarms.
_context.alarm_channel_desc: Watch: description of the alarm channel. The phone's alarms are mirrored (copied) to the watch and ring there.
_context.alarm_title: Watch: default title of a ringing alarm notification when it has no label.
_context.alarm_from_phone: Watch: subtitle of a ringing alarm that came from the phone.
_context.alarm_local: Watch: subtitle of a ringing alarm that was set on the watch itself.
_context.alarm_snooze: Watch: button on a ringing alarm (verb). Short.
_context.alarm_dismiss: Watch: button on a ringing alarm that stops it (verb). Short.
_context.call_channel: Watch: notification channel name for incoming calls happening on the phone.
_context.call_channel_desc: Watch: description of that channel. The watch only shows the call; audio stays on the phone.
_context.call_on_phone: Watch: small header above the caller name: a call is ringing on the phone.
_context.call_incoming: Watch: shown instead of the caller name when it is unknown.
_context.call_decline: Watch: button to reject the incoming call (verb). Short.
_context.call_answer: Watch: button to answer the incoming call (verb). Short.
_context.notif_channel_urgent: Watch: name of a notification channel for high-priority notifications of a phone app; %1$s is the app name (keep %1$s exactly).
_context.comms_channel: Phone: notification channel name for the always-on background service that keeps the Bluetooth link to the watch.
_context.comms_text: Phone: body of that always-on notification (title is the brand 'SHM Bridge').
_context.listener_label: Phone: name shown in Settings > Notification access. 'SHM Bridge' is a brand: keep it in Latin script; translate only the word in parentheses.
